items.rationale: Lightning overvoltage damaged a fixed installation covered under §§2.3.3 and 4.2.3; at nine metres from the hob, it is outside the five-metre exclusion. Under §§7.1.9–7.1.10, the 7.1 kW upgrade does not defeat cover, but payment is capped at €1,411 gross for an equivalent 3.5 kW unit.

Sections 7.1.9–7.1.11 cover ordinary removal, fitting, connection and commissioning at the pre-loss standard. Allow €482 gross for that work, excluding any extra labour attributable to the upgrade or decorative console.
Section 7.1.10 excludes a console chosen for appearance and not needed to install the replacement. No part of this line is payable.
Sections 7.1.9, 7.1.11 and 7.1.12 cover ordinary carriage for the insured replacement. Allow €42 gross at the equivalent unit's ordinary freight rate, without the separately billed express premium.
Section 7.1.12 excludes express and timed delivery surcharges unless approved in advance or necessary to mitigate further loss. Neither exception is indicated, so no part of the surcharge is payable.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes separately billed administrative and processing charges as contractor overhead. No part of this fee is payable.
